title: Task 1: Initialize NestJS + React monorepo
description: Scaffold root workspace with packages/backend (NestJS) and packages/frontend (Vite + React + TS). Create root package.json, backend package.json/tsconfig/nest-cli/main.ts/app.module, frontend package.json/vite.config/tsconfig/index.html/main.tsx/App.tsx, and .gitignore.

title: Task 2: Create EraModule — load era data from disk
description: Create EraModule with EraService (loadEra, listEras, getEraDir, getPromptTemplate, getGroundingDocs), era types (EraMeta, EraConfig, etc.), EraValidatorService, and era data files for 1904-second-aliyah (era.yaml, config.json, prompt_template.md, grounding_docs.md).

title: Task 3: Create SessionModule — SQLite persistence
description: Create SessionModule with SessionService (createSession, getSession, saveTurn, listSessions), session types (GameState, LocationState, etc.), DatabaseService (better-sqlite3), and session service tests. Consumes EraService.

title: Task 4: Create Ollama client
description: Create OllamaClient module with chat(), ping(), listModels() methods. Define Ollama types (ChatRequest, Message, Response, ModelInfo). Write client spec with mock HTTP tests.

title: Task 5: Create ValidationEngine — check proposed effects
description: Create ValidationEngine module with validateEffects() that accepts/rejects/clamps proposed effects against game state and era rules. Define validation types (ValidationResult, ValidatedEffect, RejectedEffect). Write validation engine tests. Pure functions, stateless.

title: Task 6: Create DMOrchestrator — build prompts and parse LLM output
description: Create DMOrchestrator module with DMOrchestratorService (processTurn), DMParserService (parse LLM JSON output), DM types (DMResponse, TurnResult). Build era prompt from template, call Ollama, parse+validate response. Consumes EraService, OllamaClient, ValidationEngine.

title: Task 7: Create GameController — API endpoints
description: Create GameController with POST /api/session (create game), GET /api/sessions (list), GET /api/session/:id (load), POST /api/turn (process action), GET /api/eras (list). Wire all modules into AppModule. Write controller tests.

title: Task 8: Create React frontend — GameScreen and components
description: Create full React game UI: API client, GameContext (useReducer state management), HomeScreen, EraSelector, GameScreen, DMNarrative, ResourcePanel, ActionInput, EventCard, JournalView, GameOverScreen. Wire into App.tsx with state-based routing.

title: Task 9: End-to-end integration test
description: Test the full pipeline end-to-end: start NestJS backend with MOCK_OLLAMA=true, test API endpoints (GET /api/eras, POST /api/session, POST /api/turn, GET /api/sessions, GET /api/session/:id), verify frontend serves HTML, drive browser through full game flow.

title: Task 10: Create JournalView and session export
description: Create JournalView component showing session details (era, turns, historical notes). Add journal toggle to GameScreen.

title: Task 11: Polish, error states, and loading UX
description: Improve loading states in GameScreen, add error state to HomeScreen for failed session load, update index.html title, add CSS reset and basic styling. Test error/loading/empty states (Ollama down, invalid session ID, empty eras).

title: Task 12: Beads import and task refactoring
description: Import refactored tasks from the plan into beads. Verify beads initialized, create JSONL import file, import via bd import, verify with bd ready.
